description: Turn any text into big ASCII art letters with 3 hand-built 5-row fonts: block, banner and small.

faqs.a: Block (bold filled), Banner (wide display) and Small (compact 3-wide) — all hand-drawn for A–Z and 0–9.
Unknown characters render as blank space and line breaks are preserved.
Results are plain text — paste them into code comments, terminals, READMEs or social bios.
faqs.q: Where can I use the output?

howto: Pick Block, Banner or Small font.
title: ASCII Art Text Generator
